instruction: Run TFLint for Terraform best practices
Run TFLint with a custom config file
Generate a Terragrunt infrastructure-live layout
Create a remote state locking DynamoDB table with Terraform
output: echo 'resource "aws_dynamodb_table" "lock" { name = "tf-lock" billing_mode = "PAY_PER_REQUEST" hash_key = "LockID" attribute { name = "LockID" type = "S" } }' > state.tf

instruction: Create an S3 bucket for Terraform state
Enable versioning on the state bucket
output: echo 'resource "aws_s3_bucket_versioning" "v" { bucket = aws_s3_bucket.state.id versioning_configuration { status = "Enabled" } }' > state.tf

instruction: Encrypt state bucket with KMS
output: echo 'resource "aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration" "enc" { bucket = aws_s3_bucket.state.id rule { apply_server_side_encryption_by_default { sse_algorithm = "AES256" } } }' > state.tf

instruction: Block public access to state bucket
output: echo 'resource "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block" "block" { bucket = aws_s3_bucket.state.id block_public_acls = true block_public_policy = true }' > state.tf

instruction: Create a Terraform module for VPC with variables
output: mkdir -p modules/vpc && echo 'variable "cidr" { type = string }' > modules/vpc/variables.tf
